title: OPTICAL SYSTEMS
description: Introduction to optical systems based on physical design and engineering principles. Fundamental geometrical and wave optics with specific emphasis on developing analytical and numerical tools used in optical engineering design. Focus on applications that employ optical systems and networks, including examples in holographic imaging, tomography, Fourier imaging, confocal microscopy, optical signal processing, fiber optic communication systems, optical interconnects and networks
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: ( ELEN E3401 ) ELEN E3401 ; or equivalent.
